title: Detection of Left Atrial Enlargement Using a Convolutional Neural Network-Enabled Electrocardiogram.
summary: A CNN read ECGs from 3,391 elderly participants who also had echocardiography, and was compared with physician performance. With a 7:3 training/validation split and a 50-per-class test set, it reached test AUC 0.949, accuracy 88.0%, sensitivity 84.0%, specificity 92.0% and F1 0.875. The authors note that further external validation is needed.
